title: Callout candidates of an intake work folder
description: Deterministic candidates (`callouts.py`) for rebar callouts, rebar grades, steel section labels, steel grades, plates, bolts and member marks, found in the text indexes of a work folder. A candidate is text that looks like a notation, never a decision. `parsed` is filled ONLY for notations the research marks verified (docs/research/vn-structural-drawing-conventions.md, 'Parsing patterns'); otherwise it is null and `unparsed_reason` says why. `rule` names the pattern or detector. Parsed numbers are copied from the text: nothing is computed (no quantity, length, weight, unit conversion) and no catalogue is consulted. `provenance` is 'derived' from the text entry's provenance, with `file` relative to the input folder and `sheet` the printed sheet number or 'unknown'. The questions are not in this document: `harness callouts` writes them, numbered, to callouts-questions.json; `question_counts` here only says how many things are asked per code.

inventory_sha256.description: Hash of the inventory.json bytes this was built from.

files.description: DXF/DWG inventory rows, sorted by path.

skipped_sheets.description: Sheets that are exact copies of an earlier sheet: not scanned, so their texts are not counted twice.

candidates.description: In scan order: files by path, text entries in index order, lines, position in the line.

blocked_entries.description: Text entries the legacy-font gate blocks (text_gate.py: non-ASCII text in an unknown, proposed or contradicted encoding) that would otherwise have yielded a candidate: listed verbatim with the reason, never read. In scan order.

rejected.description: Tool wave 3: text that matched a candidate pattern and was NOT made a candidate, each with its reason, so that every match is accounted for: a candidate (parsed, or unparsed with unparsed_reason and unparsed_code), a blocked entry, or a rejected one here. In scan order.

sheet.description: Detector sheet id; null for a text on no sheet.

kind.description: The candidate kind the text would have had.

reason_code.description: Short reason family, e.g. claimed_by_title_block, claimed_by_grids, claimed_by_levels, sheet_code.

question_counts.description: Per question code, how many things are asked over the whole project: one callout_ambiguous per ambiguous notation, one member_mark_prefix_meaning per member mark prefix, 1 grade_legacy_mapping when legacy grade groups appear, and (tool wave 3) one callout_unparsed per file and unparsed_code. Codes with none are absent. callouts-questions.json splits these per file.

scanned.description: Entries scanned (text entries minus those of skipped duplicate sheets).

file.description: Inventory path, relative to the input folder.

sheet.description: Detector sheet id ('model#01'); null when the text lies on no sheet (or the sheets document is missing).

sheet_number.description: Printed sheet number as read by the title-block detector, with its own confidence; null when none was settled.

display_text.description: The matched characters of the entry's display_text (%%c already expanded to U+00D8).

line_text.description: The whole line, whitespace collapsed and cut at 200 characters; present only when it differs from display_text.

rule.description: Pattern or detector id plus the research section that verifies it (or says it is unverified).

unparsed_reason.description: Why `parsed` is null; null when parsed.

unparsed_code.description: Tool wave 3: the reason family of an unparsed candidate (absent on a parsed one), which callout_unparsed groups by: ambiguous_notation (a notation with several readings, see `ambiguity`); grade_unverified (a grade spelling or number outside the verified list); notation_unverified (a section, plate, hole, bolt or diameter form whose field order or meaning is unverified); conflicting_values (one line gives several values, e.g. two bolt classes); member_mark_undefined (mark letters without a verified meaning); symbol_glyph_unverified (W1/W1b: a character in diameter position that is not Ø or %%c, e.g. 'ù' in an Arial style or 'Þ' in a VNI style: never decoded, asked).

ambiguity.description: Notation id of the callout_ambiguous question this candidate is referenced from; null when none.

lexical.description: member_mark only: the text split into prefix, number and suffix. A split of characters, not a reading: the prefix has no verified meaning.

confidence.description: min(rule cap, text entry confidence); forced low by case_uncertain text, unmapped characters, unknown-encoding flags and a literal diameter sign in non-Unicode text. Verified grade-B grammar is at most medium; unparsed, ambiguous and member marks are low.

flags.description: The text entry's flags, 'case_uncertain' when its case is a guess, and 'diameter_sign_literal_non_unicode' when a literal diameter sign was read from non-Unicode text.

parsed.description: Only verified notations. Numbers are as written (mm unless the name says otherwise), never computed.

oneOf.description: Ø8a150, or Ø8a100/200 (spacing_mm = 100 at the ends, spacing_mid_mm = 200 in the middle, per the research).
CI..CIV or A-I..A-IV: the group name only. Yield strength and product standard are NOT stated; never mapped to CB grades.
2 L 65 x 8: optional leading count, letter L or V as written, leg and thickness.
457x191x82 UB: nominal depth x nominal width x kg/m (BS EN 10365 serial size; verified for the UB table only, UC is not parsed). Actual dimensions differ and come from a catalogue.

mass_kg_per_m.description: The number written in the label, kg/m; not computed.

thread_label.description: The M-label found on the same line (e.g. 'M20'), copied; its meaning is unverified.

unparsed_by_code.description: Tool wave 3: unparsed candidates per unparsed_code.

rejected.description: Tool wave 3: length of the document's rejected list.

rejected_by_reason.description: Tool wave 3: rejected matches per reason_code.
